invariants.rationale: Since performClusteringWithRecordList (the call providing result) is likely contractually required to return a non-null List<WriteStatus>, it is important that runClusteringForGroup also never returns null.
The method immediately dereferences clusteringGroup (calls getSlices()) and uses it for fetching input, so a null value would cause an exception before the exit point.
The method passes strategyParams directly to other methods, which would likely expect a non-null map.
